points.statement: This work demonstrates an instrument for simultaneous mapping and spatial correlation of key properties of a sensor chip.
points.quote: This work demonstrates a quantum diamond microscope (QDM) for the simultaneous mapping and spatial correlation of key properties of a millimeter-scale NV-diamond sensor chip, including: NV ensemble photoluminescence (PL) amplitude, spin-lattice relaxation time (T1), and homogeneous and inhomogeneous spin coherence lifetimes (T2 and T∗2{}_{2}^{*}), as well as lattice stress/strain, birefringence magnitude, and birefringence angle of the diamond crystal.

points.statement: The authors demonstrate an instrument that can image several parameters relevant to ensemble sensing across a diamond plate.
points.quote: Here we demonstrate an "all-in-one QDM" that can image several parameters relevant to NV ensemble sensing across a millimeter diamond plate, including NV spin resonance lineshift, decoherence, depolarization time scales, stress/strain, and birefringence.

points.statement: Measurements are co-registered to simplify analysis of complex features appearing across modalities.
points.quote: Measurements are co-registered to simplify analysis of complex features that appear across modalities.

points.statement: Optical excitation pathways are exchanged using a flipper mirror, offering epifluorescent and non-focused full-sample excitation options.
points.quote: Two optical excitation pathways are exchanged by use of a flipper mirror, with an epifluorescent option and a non-focused full-sample excitation option.

points.statement: Microwaves are coupled into an edge inductive gap of a resonator, creating a strong, homogeneous microwave field across the sample.
points.quote: Microwaves (MWs) are coupled in to an edge inductive gap of the loop gap resonator (LGR), creating a strong, homogeneous MW field across the full NV-diamond sample.

points.statement: Permanent magnets create a uniform bias magnetic field that shifts spin resonances to isolate or overlap resonance frequencies as needed.
points.quote: Permanent magnets create a uniform bias magnetic field that Zeeman shifts NV spin resonances in order to isolate or overlap resonance frequencies as needed.

points.statement: A light source with linear polarization control and a circular polarization filter can be switched to create a transmission measurement of optical birefringence using the same objective and camera.
points.quote: An LED with linear polarization control and appropriate circular polarization filter can be switched for the top objective and bottom filters, respectively, to create a transmission measurement of optical birefringence using the same below-sample objective and camera.

points.statement: Laser light for excitation can be sent through a top objective for point excitation or to a periscope that illuminates a region of the diamond along a shallow angle.
points.quote: Laser light for NV excitation can be sent through a top objective for point-excitation, or to a periscope that illuminates a mm-scale region of the diamond along a shallow angle.

points.statement: Photoluminescence collection pathways exist: a top objective can collect and filter epifluorescence for a photodiode or spectrometer, or an imaging objective beneath the sample can direct light to a camera for wide-field imaging.
points.quote: Similarly there are two collection pathways for NV photoluminescence (PL), the top objective can be used to collect epifluorescence and spatially filter it before being sent to either a photodiode for time resolved confocal measurement or a fiber-coupled spectrometer for spectroscopy; or the PL can be collected by an imaging objective mounted beneath the sample space, which directs light to a camera for wide-field imaging.

points.statement: The combination of options affords flexibility, allowing collection and correlation of confocal and imaged measurements.
points.quote: This combination of options affords great flexibility: e.g., the all-in-one QDM can collect and correlate confocal and imaged NV measurements.

points.statement: This microwave capability is enabled by using a metallic loop gap resonator.
points.quote: This MW capability is enabled by the use of a metallic loop gap resonator (LGR) innovated at MIT-LL.
